posts.title: Testing "exotic" p2p VPN
posts.description: How did the moose begin My standard "everyday" solution when it comes to connecting computers into a single network is Wireguard. Wireguard is good, supports p2p, and generally has no downsides. The downsides come from having part of my home infrastructure located in territory controlled by a country that has blocked Wireguard by signatures.
